sourcePlan.policy: All regular actual candidate inputs, driver and as-run snapshots, raw failures, receipts, full saves, unedited PNG and existing original producer archives are included. No symlink traversal, secret helper/provider or upload requests/responses. Future live outputs only archived after owned run is ended, input guard checked, and source/output inventory stable. ROOT05 existing Git original ZIPs preserved separately; no duplicates of repository-wide docs/history/private MZ.
freezeRequirements: All owned run receipts ended, input guard preserved, no owned child live
Each producer explicitly finalizes its mutable source/output namespace
Before and after full gather SHA stable; failed collector retained but not uploaded
Decoded archive credential count as well as outer regular-byte count equals zero
Keep every original path and producer archive; no provenance loss from deduplication
